items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.

items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复与iPSC药物发现的研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾性综述，涵盖从基础神经发育研究到iPSC临床应用的全链条工作。核心内容包括：Musashi RNA结合蛋白的发现、神经干细胞分离方法的建立、脊髓损伤的临床前研究，以及全球首个iPSC来源神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的人体临床试验。在ALS领域，作者团队建立了患者来源iPSC药物筛选平台，发现帕金森病药物Ropinirole可作为ALS治疗候选药物，并通过反向转化研究将细胞表型与临床反应相关联。
items.insight: 这篇文章由该领域核心研究者亲述，串联了从Musashi蛋白基础发现到iPSC移植临床试验的完整转化路径，对ALS研究者理解iPSC药物筛选平台（如Ropinirole的发现逻辑）和神经干细胞移植策略的演进具有直接的参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和iPSC药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，涵盖损伤病理生理学分析、分子干预，以及使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终促成了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首个人体临床研究。与此同时，作者开发了患者来源的iPSC平台用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选将Ropinirole确定为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 文章发表于2026年，由iPSC神经移植首个人体试验的领导者撰写，系统总结了iPSC药物发现（含ALS候选药物Ropinirole）与再生医学的最新整合进展，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135例ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积也存在性别差异。这些差异在调整年龄、BMI等变量后部分仍存在，提示性别和体型可能影响ALS中炎症和神经肌肉指标的解读。研究为观察性设计，缺乏健康对照组，不能确定这些差异是否由ALS本身引起。
items.insight: 该研究提示性别是ALS临床评估中不可忽视的变量，可能影响炎症标志物和超声测量的解读，对设计分层治疗和生物标志物研究具有参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积存在性别差异，部分差异在调整后仍显著。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法区分ALS特异性效应；横断面设计无法推断因果关系；样本量有限且为单中心。
aiRead.watchNext: 未来研究应纳入健康对照、纵向随访和身体成分评估，以验证性别差异的疾病特异性和预后价值。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。系统性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否持续存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入135例ALS患者。分析常规炎症标志物（包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率）以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行性别间比较，并应用错误发现率校正以处理多重检验。采用多变量线性回归分析，调整年龄、病程、体重指数、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍显著不同，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析中关联不稳定。探索性二次分析显示，完全调整后女性患者大腿抬高时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照，观察到的超声差异不能特异性地归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究，以阐明这些观察的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的回顾性队列数据，聚焦ALS中性别相关的炎症和超声差异，为个体化评估提供了新视角。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.

items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化症疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用自然发生的犬退行性脊髓病（DM）作为SOD1相关ALS的模型，系统检查了本体感觉通路（脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核、背根神经节）的病理改变。研究发现这些感觉通路存在显著的轴突变性和SOD1蛋白聚集，并与犬只的共济失调症状相关。值得注意的是，部分携带风险基因纯合子的犬只并未发病，提示存在其他修饰因素。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS研究中感觉通路病理学相对被忽视的空白，通过自然发生的犬类疾病模型，为理解SOD1突变如何导致非运动症状（如感觉障碍和共济失调）提供了直接的病理学证据，并提示感觉通路病变可能是ALS早期临床表现的重要组成部分。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否探索SOD1突变导致感觉神经元变性的具体分子机制，以及这些感觉通路病变在人类ALS患者中的对应表现和作为早期生物标志物的潜力。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不清楚。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS（尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例）具有相似性。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理学是否与盆肢一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自患有早期和晚期DM的彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬及年龄匹配对照组的该通路的感觉系统组成部分。该疾病的特征在于脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理学、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其包裹髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在盆肢感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理学。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理学可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬只并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理学，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中常被忽视的本体感觉通路病理，利用与人类SOD1-ALS高度相似的犬类自然疾病模型，具有直接的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（多中心回顾性队列，含倾向评分匹配历史对照）
items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46名SOD1-ALS患者的真实世界数据显示，使用Tofersen治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R）显著减缓，血液NfL水平显著下降。与历史对照相比，Tofersen组生存期更长，死亡风险降低约66%。研究为观察性回顾性设计，存在固有局限性，但为Tofersen在真实临床环境中的获益提供了支持性证据。
items.insight: 该研究是SOD1-ALS靶向治疗领域重要的真实世界证据，在随机对照试验之外独立验证了Tofersen对功能衰退和NfL生物标志物的影响，并首次在法国多中心人群中提示生存获益，对临床实践和后续研究设计具有直接参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: Tofersen治疗12个月显著减缓ALSFRS-R进展率（0.53→0.22点/月）并降低NfL水平（89.0→29.2 pg/ml）；与历史对照相比，死亡风险降低66%（HR=0.34）。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计、样本量较小（N=46）、ALSFRS-R对功能变化敏感性有限、历史对照可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Tofersen长期（>12个月）疗效与安全性数据、其他SOD1突变亚型的差异反应，以及正在进行的随机对照试验结果是否与真实世界证据一致。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在真实世界环境中评估Tofersen对法国超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALSFRS-R进展率从基线的0.53 ± 0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22 ± 0.3点/月（P = .006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2 ± 19.5 pg/ml（P = .004）。与倾向评分匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P = .30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P = .006）。倾向评分匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P = .004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P = .03）。Tofersen似乎与较慢的功能衰退和NfL水平降低相关。尽管必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，但这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.

items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了肠道微生物群通过肠-脑轴影响神经系统疾病（包括ALS）的现有证据，指出不同疾病存在特异性的微生物特征，并讨论了益生菌、饮食干预等微生物靶向策略的潜力。作者强调，目前多数机制证据来自动物模型，人类研究尚不充分，临床转化面临挑战。

items.abstractZh: 微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制连接胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，许多机制性观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了肠道微生物群在维持CNS稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经系统通讯，以及生物活性微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验研究均报告了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中的疾病特异性微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪便微生物群移植以及靶向微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案方面的显著异质性仍限制了这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总体而言，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的有价值框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新研究，聚焦于ALS等疾病的肠道微生物特异性通路，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: The Anterior Belly of the Digastric Muscle as a Novel Target for Needle Electromyography in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Needle electromyography (EMG) in the bulbar region aids in the diagnosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) but remains technically challenging. The genioglossus muscle (GM) is commonly examined; however, pain and poor relaxation may limit its evaluation. The trapezius is an alternative target but is innervated by the spinal accessory nerve. We investigated the utility of the anterior belly of the digastric muscle (ABDM), innervated by the trigeminal nerve, for bulbar EMG evaluation. In this unblinded, prospective observational study, consecutive patients with suspected ALS underwent needle EMG of the ABDM, GM, masseter muscle (MM), and trapezius. Relaxation levels, EMG abnormalities, and pain (100-mm visual analog scale [VAS]) were assessed. Twenty-seven clinically diagnosed ALS patients were analyzed. Relaxation was better in the ABDM than in the GM (p < 0.001) and comparable to that in the MM and trapezius. Fasciculation potentials were detected more often in the ABDM (52%) than in the GM (0%) and MM (22%; p = 0.039) and were comparable to the trapezius (59%). Chronic denervation occurred at similar frequencies across muscles (33%-59%). The combination of abnormal spontaneous activity and chronic denervation was most frequent in the ABDM (37%). Pain was lower with the ABDM (median VAS score of 21) than with the GM (28; p = 0.0052) and MM (32; p < 0.001) and was similar to the trapezius (23). The ABDM may be a practical additional target for bulbar EMG in ALS, with favorable relaxation, lower pain, and potentially improved electrodiagnostic yield.
items.titleZh: 二腹肌前腹作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症针极肌电图检查的新靶点
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了二腹肌前腹（ABDM）作为ALS球部肌电图检查新靶点的可行性。结果显示，与传统的颏舌肌相比，ABDM在患者放松程度和疼痛控制方面表现更优，且束颤电位检出率更高（52% vs 0%），与斜方肌相当。ABDM可能提高球部EMG的诊断效率，为ALS的神经电生理评估提供更舒适、更有效的选择。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS球部肌电图检查提供了新的肌肉靶点，可能改善患者耐受性和诊断准确性，对早期诊断和临床试验中的生物标志物评估具有潜在价值。

items.abstractZh: 球部区域的针极肌电图（EMG）有助于肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的诊断，但在技术上仍具挑战性。颏舌肌（GM）是常用检查部位，但疼痛和放松不良可能限制其评估。斜方肌是替代靶点，但由副神经支配。我们研究了由三叉神经支配的二腹肌前腹（ABDM）在球部EMG评估中的效用。在这项非盲、前瞻性观察性研究中，连续疑似ALS患者接受了ABDM、GM、咬肌（MM）和斜方肌的针极EMG检查。评估了放松程度、EMG异常和疼痛（100mm视觉模拟量表[VAS]）。分析了27例临床确诊的ALS患者。ABDM的放松程度优于GM（p < 0.001），与MM和斜方肌相当。ABDM的束颤电位检出率（52%）高于GM（0%）和MM（22%；p = 0.039），与斜方肌（59%）相当。慢性失神经在各肌肉中的发生频率相似（33%-59%）。异常自发电活动与慢性失神经的组合在ABDM中最常见（37%）。ABDM的疼痛评分（中位VAS 21）低于GM（28；p = 0.0052）和MM（32；p < 0.001），与斜方肌（23）相似。ABDM可能作为ALS球部EMG的实用附加靶点，具有较好的放松程度、较低的疼痛和潜在更高的电诊断阳性率。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提出了一种新的、更易操作的球部EMG靶点，具有直接的临床转化价值，可能优化ALS的诊断流程。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.
items.titleZh: ALS患者中巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，ALS患者血清和脑脊液中针对ATCV-1病毒的抗体水平显著高于健康对照，且该病毒能优先感染人M1型巨噬细胞，增强促炎因子（如IL-6）并抑制抗炎因子（如IL-10）的产生，提示病毒感染可能通过加剧神经炎症参与ALS发病。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的病毒病因学提供了新证据，将口腔微生物组中的巨型病毒ATCV-1与巨噬细胞极化及炎症失衡联系起来，可能为ALS的疾病修饰治疗提供新靶点。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) 是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究表明，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。此外，与健康对照相比，ALS患者血清中针对ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著升高，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液样本，再次证实ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究者使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别用ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1细胞的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1细胞。M1 THP-1细胞初始高ISRE启动子活性被ATCV-1的MCP聚糖抑制。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1细胞在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1细胞本身高水平的IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步升高。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1细胞产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病的发展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合临床样本和体外实验，首次在独立队列中验证ATCV-1抗体升高，并揭示其对人M1巨噬细胞的偏好性感染，具有ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种与军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项针对美国退伍军人的大规模纵向队列研究（覆盖约990万人）发现，军种和军衔与ALS发病风险显著相关。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者的ALS风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役年限越长风险反而越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中尤为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险，但具体暴露因素尚待识别。
items.insight: 这项研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役细节与ALS风险关联的分析之一，首次系统揭示了军种和军衔对ALS风险的差异化影响。其发现挑战了以往将军事服役视为单一风险因素的简单认知，提示特定环境暴露（如空军、海军和海岸警卫队可能涉及的电磁场、化学品或特殊训练）可能在ALS发病中起重要作用。对于ALS研究者而言，这为寻找新的环境风险因素和阐明ALS病因提供了重要线索，也为军人健康防护和退伍军人监测策略提供了依据。

aiRead.keyFinding: 美国退伍军人中，空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者ALS风险高于陆军（HR 1.15-1.29），海军陆战队风险较低（HR 0.78）；军官风险约为士兵的1.6-1.7倍；年轻退伍军人中的军种差异更显著。
aiRead.limitation: 观察性研究无法确立因果关系；未测量具体环境暴露因素；依赖医疗记录识别ALS可能低估病例；退伍军人健康管理局人群可能不能完全代表所有美国退伍军人。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究应聚焦于识别空军、海军和海岸警卫队特有的具体暴露因素（如电磁场、化学制剂、训练强度等），并探索这些因素与ALS遗传易感性的交互作用。

items.abstractZh: 军事服役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服役的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军事人员中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与偶发性ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入了2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发性ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发性ALS病例，平均年龄=56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄=42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役的发病率较低（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性中最大（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51），在年长男性中最小（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而有显著差异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的最新大规模退伍军人队列数据（随访至2024年），首次细致刻画了军种和军衔与ALS风险的关联，具有直接的ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: Regenerative strategies for ALS: stem cells and extracellular vesicles.
items.summary: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is caused by progressive degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons. The disease is late onset, and to date, no early diagnosis is possible. Patients with ALS have a 5-year survival rate since diagnosis. Though recent studies highlighted the possible mechanisms of motor neuron degeneration in ALS, the treatment options are extremely limited. This underscores the urgent need to develop effective therapeutic strategies that can prolong patient survival and ultimately slow/halt ALS progression. Extracellular vesicles released from the degenerative milieu contribute to ALS propagation and progression by shuttling misfolded proteins, proinflammatory cytokines, and neurotoxins; thus, they could serve as a biomarker for diagnosis and prognosis. The advancement of stem cell-based therapies for neurodegenerative diseases and the evolving understanding of extracellular vesicles as potential biotherapeutics provide a ray of hope for millions of patients suffering from neurological disorders/neurodegenerative diseases like ALS.

items.titleZh: ALS的再生策略：干细胞与细胞外囊泡
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述讨论了ALS的再生治疗策略，重点在于干细胞疗法和细胞外囊泡（EVs）。文章指出，EVs在ALS的病理传播中起关键作用，同时也可作为诊断和预后的生物标志物。干细胞疗法和EVs作为生物治疗药物是当前研究的热点，为ALS治疗提供了新方向，但尚处于早期阶段。
items.insight: 该综述整合了干细胞和细胞外囊泡在ALS治疗中的最新进展，强调了EVs的双重角色（病理传播介质和潜在生物标志物/治疗载体），为ALS研究者提供了再生策略的全面视角，有助于指导未来的转化研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: 细胞外囊泡在ALS进展中传播病理，并可作为生物标志物；干细胞和EVs作为再生治疗策略具有潜力。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据；干细胞和EVs疗法仍处于临床前或早期临床阶段，疗效未证实。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注干细胞或EVs疗法在ALS动物模型及早期临床试验中的具体结果，以及EVs作为生物标志物的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）由上下运动神经元的进行性变性引起。该疾病发病较晚，迄今无法早期诊断。ALS患者的5年生存率自诊断时起计算。尽管近期研究强调了ALS中运动神经元变性的可能机制，但治疗选择极为有限。这凸显了开发有效治疗策略的迫切需求，以延长患者生存期并最终减缓或阻止ALS进展。从退行性微环境中释放的细胞外囊泡通过转运错误折叠蛋白、促炎细胞因子和神经毒素，促进ALS的传播和进展；因此，它们可作为诊断和预后的生物标志物。干细胞疗法在神经退行性疾病中的进展，以及对细胞外囊泡作为潜在生物治疗药物的不断认识，为患有ALS等神经系统疾病/神经退行性疾病的数百万患者带来了希望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，聚焦于干细胞和细胞外囊泡这一新兴再生策略，直接关联ALS治疗转化价值，反映了当前研究的前沿方向。

items.title: Population-Level Nucleotide Diversity and Genetic Differentiation at SOD1 Across Global Human Populations.
items.summary: The SOD1 gene encodes superoxide dismutase 1, an antioxidant enzyme in which pathogenic variants cause a subset of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Although the clinical and molecular consequences of SOD1 variants are well established, its locus-wide population genetic architecture has not been systematically characterized across global populations. To characterize patterns of genetic diversity, population differentiation, and evolutionary constraint across the SOD1 locus in worldwide human populations. We analyzed genomic variation spanning the SOD1 region in the five continental populations of the 1000 Genomes Project. Nucleotide diversity (π), fixation index (FST), and allele frequency distributions were estimated using sliding-window analyses. Bootstrap resampling was used to compare diversity within and outside the coding region. Recent positive selection was assessed using XP-nSL, and codon-based evolutionary analyses were performed using primate SOD1 orthologs. The coding region consistently exhibited a twofold to threefold reduction in nucleotide diversity relative to adjacent genomic sequences across all populations. Bootstrap analyses confirmed significantly lower diversity within the locus than in flanking regions (p < 0.05 in all populations). Population differentiation was low (mean FST ≈ 0.03) and showed no pronounced peaks within the coding interval, whereas allele frequency distributions were broadly similar across continental populations. XP-nSL analyses detected no evidence of population-specific recent selective sweeps. Codon-based analyses identified only 31 variable codons among 155 analyzed positions, six codons under negative selection, and no evidence of positive selection. The SOD1 locus exhibits reduced standing genetic variation, limited continental differentiation, and strong evolutionary conservation, consistent with sustained functional constraint. These findings provide a comprehensive population genetic framework for interpreting genetic variation at this medically important locus.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性研究（群体遗传学分析）
items.titleZh: 全球人类群体中SOD1基因的群体水平核苷酸多样性与遗传分化
items.summaryZh: 这项研究分析了全球五大洲人群的SOD1基因变异，发现该基因的编码区核苷酸多样性显著低于周围区域，表明其受到强烈的进化约束。不同大陆人群间的遗传分化很小，且未检测到近期正选择信号。这意味着SOD1基因在人类进化中高度保守，其变异可能主要受净化选择影响。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统描绘了SOD1基因座在全球人群中的群体遗传学图谱，为区分致病性变异与良性多态性提供了关键参考，有助于ALS遗传咨询和变异解读。

aiRead.keyFinding: SOD1编码区核苷酸多样性显著降低，群体分化低，且无正选择证据，表明该基因受强功能约束。
aiRead.limitation: 仅基于1000 Genomes数据，可能未涵盖所有全球人群；未直接关联ALS表型。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究可结合ALS患者队列，评估SOD1罕见变异的致病性，并探索其他ALS相关基因的群体遗传特征。

items.abstractZh: SOD1基因编码超氧化物歧化酶1，这是一种抗氧化酶，其致病性变异会导致肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的一部分病例。尽管SOD1变异的临床和分子后果已明确，但其全基因座的群体遗传结构在全球人群中尚未被系统表征。本研究旨在描述全球人类群体中SOD1基因座的遗传多样性、群体分化和进化约束模式。我们分析了1000基因组计划中五个大陆人群的SOD1区域基因组变异。使用滑动窗口分析估计核苷酸多样性（π）、固定指数（FST）和等位基因频率分布。使用Bootstrap重采样比较编码区内外的多样性。使用XP-nSL评估近期正选择，并使用灵长类SOD1直系同源物进行基于密码子的进化分析。在所有人群中，编码区的核苷酸多样性相对于相邻基因组序列持续表现出2至3倍的降低。Bootstrap分析确认基因座内多样性显著低于侧翼区域（所有人群p < 0.05）。群体分化较低（平均FST ≈ 0.03），编码区间内无显著峰值，而等位基因频率分布在大陆人群间大致相似。XP-nSL分析未检测到群体特异性近期选择性清除的证据。基于密码子的分析在155个分析位点中仅识别出31个可变密码子，6个密码子处于负选择下，且无正选择证据。SOD1基因座表现出降低的现有遗传变异、有限的大陆分化以及强烈的进化保守性，与持续的功能约束一致。这些发现为解释这一医学重要基因座的遗传变异提供了全面的群体遗传学框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于最新的大规模基因组数据（1000 Genomes），首次全面评估SOD1基因座的群体遗传特征，为ALS相关变异的临床解读提供了直接的进化生物学依据。

items.title: Dysregulation of arginase and arginine pathways in neurodegenerative diseases: Metabolic and cellular dysfunction and therapeutic implications.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases are increasingly recognized as disorders associated with metabolic dysfunction with arginine metabolism emerging as a significant contributor. Arginase, by regulating the balance between arginine and ornithine, is positioned at the crossroads of multiple arginine metabolic pathways, thereby controlling a variety of cellular processes essential for proper brain homeostasis. Chronic disruption of these pathways may lead to dysfunction of neurons and glia ultimately resulting in the induction of neurodegenerative processes. In this review, based on data from patients and experimental models, we synthesize and critically evaluate evidence demonstrating alterations in arginase isoenzymes and associated metabolic pathways in Alzheimer's Parkinson's and Huntington's diseases, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We discuss mechanisms through which dysregulation of arginase and arginine metabolism may contribute to neurodegeneration, including disturbances in nitrogen metabolism, oxidative and nitrosative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and neuroinflammation. Based on this body of evidence, we propose therapeutic strategies targeting arginase-related pathways, with the aim of preserving cellular metabolic homeostasis to ameliorate disease progression. Finally, we outline directions for future research, emphasizing that a proper understanding of the physiological roles of arginase isoenzymes and their disease-, stage-, and cell-specific dysregulation will be essential for the development of effective metabolically targeted therapies against neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中精氨酸酶和精氨酸通路的失调：代谢与细胞功能障碍及治疗意义
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦精氨酸酶在神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）中的作用，指出精氨酸代谢失调通过氮代谢紊乱、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和神经炎症等机制促进神经退行性过程。作者提出靶向精氨酸酶相关通路可能成为治疗策略，并强调理解精氨酸酶同工酶的疾病和细胞特异性失调对开发代谢靶向疗法至关重要。
items.insight: 该综述系统整合了ALS及其他主要神经退行性疾病中精氨酸代谢失调的证据，为研究者提供了代谢靶向治疗的新视角，特别是精氨酸酶作为潜在药物靶点的转化价值值得ALS领域关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: 精氨酸酶和精氨酸代谢通路在ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和亨廷顿病中均存在失调，通过多种机制促进神经退行性过程，靶向该通路可能具有治疗潜力。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，其结论基于现有文献的整合，缺乏原始实验数据；精氨酸酶同工酶在不同疾病、阶段和细胞类型中的具体作用仍需进一步阐明。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对精氨酸酶通路的临床前干预研究，以及ALS患者中精氨酸代谢标志物的纵向临床研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病日益被认为是与代谢功能障碍相关的疾病，其中精氨酸代谢被确定为重要贡献因素。精氨酸酶通过调节精氨酸和鸟氨酸之间的平衡，处于多条精氨酸代谢通路的交叉点，从而控制对正常大脑稳态至关重要的多种细胞过程。这些通路的慢性破坏可能导致神经元和胶质细胞功能障碍，最终诱发神经退行性过程。本综述基于患者和实验模型的数据，综合并批判性评估了显示阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中精氨酸酶同工酶及相关代谢通路改变的证据。我们讨论了精氨酸酶和精氨酸代谢失调可能促进神经退行性的机制，包括氮代谢紊乱、氧化和亚硝化应激、线粒体功能障碍和神经炎症。基于这些证据，我们提出了靶向精氨酸酶相关通路的治疗策略，旨在维持细胞代谢稳态以改善疾病进展。最后，我们概述了未来研究方向，强调正确理解精氨酸酶同工酶的生理作用及其疾病、阶段和细胞特异性失调，对于开发针对神经退行性疾病的有效代谢靶向疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新患者和实验模型数据，系统阐述了精氨酸酶通路失调在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的机制及治疗潜力，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: TRIM16 attenuates TDP43-mediated oxidative injury by coordinating Nrf2 activation and TFR1 autophagic degradation.
items.summary: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP43) aggregation is a well-established pathological hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and related neurodegenerative disorders, contributing significantly to oxidative stress and neuronal injury. Here, we report that the M337V mutation in TDP43 exacerbates its proteotoxicity relative to the wild-type protein. Concurrently, multi-omics analysis revealed a pronounced downregulation of TRIM16 in motor neuron-like cells expressing either wild-type or M337V mutant TDP43. Functional studies demonstrated that TRIM16 overexpression effectively mitigated oxidative stress, restored mitochondrial integrity, and suppressed ferroptosis. Mechanistically, TRIM16 promoted the ubiquitination and degradation of Keap1, thereby facilitating the activation of Nrf2-mediated antioxidant genes. Furthermore, we identified the iron import receptor TFR1 as a novel ubiquitination substrate of TRIM16. TRIM16 mediated the ubiquitination of TFR1 and targeted it for p62-dependent autophagic degradation, which in turn reduced iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation. Collectively, our findings establish TRIM16 as a pivotal suppressor of TDP43-induced toxicity by orchestrating dual cytoprotective pathways to enhance cellular resilience, highlighting its promising therapeutic potential for TDP43 proteinopathy.
items.titleZh: TRIM16通过协调Nrf2激活和TFR1自噬降解减轻TDP43介导的氧化损伤
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现TRIM16蛋白能对抗ALS相关TDP43突变（M337V）引起的细胞损伤。TRIM16通过两条途径发挥作用：一是促进Keap1降解以激活Nrf2抗氧化通路，二是介导铁输入受体TFR1的自噬降解以减少铁积累和脂质过氧化。在运动神经元样细胞中过表达TRIM16可减轻氧化应激、恢复线粒体功能并抑制铁死亡，提示其可能成为TDP43蛋白病的治疗靶点。
items.insight: 该研究首次将TRIM16确立为TDP43毒性的关键抑制因子，揭示了其通过同时调控抗氧化（Nrf2）和铁代谢（TFR1）的双重保护机制，为ALS中TDP43蛋白病提供了新的治疗靶点和机制理解。

items.abstractZh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP43）聚集是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）及相关神经退行性疾病的公认病理标志，显著促进氧化应激和神经元损伤。本研究报告，与野生型蛋白相比，TDP43的M337V突变加剧了其蛋白毒性。同时，多组学分析显示，在表达野生型或M337V突变型TDP43的运动神经元样细胞中，TRIM16显著下调。功能研究表明，TRIM16过表达有效减轻氧化应激、恢复线粒体完整性并抑制铁死亡。机制上，TRIM16促进Keap1的泛素化和降解，从而促进Nrf2介导的抗氧化基因的激活。此外，作者将铁输入受体TFR1鉴定为TRIM16的新型泛素化底物。TRIM16介导TFR1的泛素化，并使其靶向p62依赖性自噬降解，进而减少铁积累和脂质过氧化。总之，研究结果确立了TRIM16通过协调双重细胞保护途径增强细胞韧性，从而成为TDP43诱导毒性的关键抑制因子，凸显了其在TDP43蛋白病中的潜在治疗价值。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次揭示TRIM16通过双重细胞保护通路（Nrf2激活与TFR1自噬降解）对抗ALS核心病理蛋白TDP43的毒性，具有直接的ALS转化治疗价值。

items.title: Exosomal miRNA in cerebrospinal fluid as biomarkers for neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Cerebrospinal fluid protein biomarkers, such as the Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio, phosphorylated tau, and neurofilament light chain, have significantly advanced the diagnostic process for Alzheimer's disease. Nonetheless, these biomarkers face challenges in effectively distinguishing Alzheimer's disease from frontotemporal dementia or Parkinson's disease from dementia with Lewy bodies. This limitation arises from overlapping protein profiles and the variability inherent in immunoassay techniques. A complementary class of analytes is exosomal microRNAs in cerebrospinal fluid, where these non-coding RNAs are secreted by neurons, astrocytes, and microglia, are resistant to RNase degradation, and have a disease-specific expression pattern. This review critically evaluates the existing evidence of cerebrospinal fluid exosomal miRNAs as diagnostic biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia, Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Exosome isolation techniques and detection platform characteristics were compared using RT-qPCR, droplet digital PCR, and small RNA sequencing. Pre-analytical factors, such as collection protocols, hemolysis contamination, freeze-thaw cycling, and circadian sampling variation, were assessed. miRNA profiling data based on disease stratification, receiver operating characteristic performance of the combinatorial panel, and strategies combining exosomal miRNAs with core cerebrospinal fluid proteins were synthesized. This article brings together disease-specific miRNA signatures, pre-analytical standardization needs, and diagnostic accuracy analyses in a translational model to fill the literature gap and form the basis for developing exosomal miRNA panels for rigorously validated clinical laboratory practice.
